notes.title: Small Update
notes.content:
Fixed bug where some tutorial entries might get skipped if the player completes a future tutorial task in advance
 Improved text formatting and wording in tutorial
 Changed sound effect for tutorial checkbox

notes.title: Added New Tutorial
notes.content:
- Added new comprehensive tutorial that covers everything from machine creation and programming to blueprints.
- Tutorial now features check boxes to make it easier to clear and keep track of all the sub tasks of a given tutorial entry.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41589453/27d0755be66ecb60afcee9d7c3f3aa125a1a5621.png

notes.title: Cleaner Grid Rendering In Level2 And Small QOL Update
notes.content:
- Fixed problem where grid wasn't rendered nicely on a certain surface in Level 2.
  - Machines now assume the pose saved in the first move command on machine copy / machine put into inventory. This makes placing machines considerably easier since the first move command usually contains the rotations necessary to reach a block on the ground and the machine will now already be in initial-pickup-position automatically (QOL update).

notes.title: Added Placement Grid and Fixed Bugs
notes.content:
- Added placement grid to make it easier to align and adjust machine position while placing.
- Fixed bug where UI didn't work as intended on all resolutions other than 1920x1080.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41589453/8c4b927b7daefe1d4b57d3d1bf7c63521b3194f2.png

Let me add few words about the placement grid. I want to add functionality to make it possible to
  - Show the grid on already placed selected machines.
  - Check the x, y coordinates of already placed machines.
  - Nudge already placed machines to the left/right/up/down.

I am working on the stuff above. If there's anything you might want to add let me know. It will take at least a week however, since it's holiday season. I will be away for a few days enjoying time with my family. Happy holidays!
